余生皆假期
About Me 
Hello, I'm Steve . welcome to my digital garden. 
I am a product manager and children's story narrative designer with experience in the gaming and online education industries. 
With the development of AI, over the past three years, I have participated in several AI-related projects, including intelligent customer service and children's companion toys. 
I am very passionate about AIGC (AI-generated content), perhaps because I am also a photography and illustration enthusiast. I run a somewhat irregularly updated AI information and exchange community. I enjoy researching new and interesting AI tools and love using VIBE CODING to bring my creative ideas to life. 
I lived and worked in Beijing for nearly twenty years, and I am currently based in Chengdu while working in Suzhou.
